assets.export: harper-cli 3.2.0 words; decode quoted strings, lowercase, deduplicate, sort, LF
assets.role: protected vocabulary only; no frequency or candidate weights

tokenization: Unicode UAX #29 words, protected source spans, immediate word bigrams within sentence
contractions: Protect dictionary-recognized apostrophe words, recognizing curly apostrophes without changing typography. Force im to I'm and cant, dont, wont, isnt, arent, wasnt, werent, doesnt, didnt, havent, hasnt, hadnt, couldnt, wouldnt, shouldnt, mustnt, and neednt to their apostrophized negative contractions. Capitalize first-person contractions.
smoothing: Equal interpolation between observed conditional bigrams and add-one unigram probabilities
